Thanks for the context, Karthik — reviewed the numbers and the competing offer details. Quick notes: 

- 140k base is ~5% above our SDE2 midpoint for SF; it is within manager approval for spot adjustments but requires a 1.5x hiring manager justification in Greenfield bands.
- 10% bonus target is standard and fine.
- 12k RSU grant (approx $12k at current price) is low relative to market where many companies are pushing higher RSU refresh potential. We can keep RSU at 12k and move incremental comp into a one‑time sign-on if leadership wants to avoid shifting the band baseline.

Options to present to the candidate (ranked by preference for cost predictability):
1) Keep base at 140k, 10% bonus, RSU 12k + one‑time sign‑on 10k (paid over first payroll) — this keeps annual comp predictable and doesn't permanently move band.
2) Reduce base to 136k, increase RSU to 18k (4y) — more upside, less fixed cash.
3) Approve 140k base + a modest RSU increase to 15k if you want an even split.

If Kimberly can sign the above as within standard authority, I recommend option 1. If we need exec approval, flag quickly so we can respond to candidate.

-Marissa
Compensation Partner
